skills.name: Night Jaguar

greatSpell.name: Night and Wind

skills.name: Borrowed Power

skills.name: Full Moon

skills.name: Loser's Sacrifice
skills.effect: 36-44 damage, drains 20⚡, rival -20% damage for 2 turns

skills.name: Golden Flash
skills.effect: 17-23 damage, rival 20% to miss for 1 turns

skills.name: Alicanto's Glow

greatSpell.name: Gold Vein

skills.name: Condor Dive

skills.name: High Flight

skills.name: Hex

greatSpell.effect: 42-52 damage, rival 35% to miss for 2 turns

skills.name: Pombero's Whistle

skills.name: Curupira's Feet
skills.effect: 50% dodge for 2 turns, rival 20% to miss for 2 turns

greatSpell.name: Endless Forest
greatSpell.effect: 44-54 damage, rival 40% to miss for 2 turns

nahuales.name: Quetzalcóatl
nahuales.passive: Sky and earth: it attacks from the air: your hits ignore block and shield, and +7% evasion.

nahuales.name: La Llorona
nahuales.passive: Wail: the rival hits you 14% less and loses 3 energy per turn.

nahuales.name: Nahual
nahuales.passive: A thousand shapes: copies the passive of the rival's companion; if they have none, you hit 10% harder.

nahuales.name: Yacumama
nahuales.passive: Mother of water: every 6 turns it raises a giant wave (11-15 damage). In raids, every 5 hits.

nahuales.name: Apu Condor
nahuales.passive: Dive: on your first turn it dives onto the rival (12-16 damage).

nahuales.name: Muqui
nahuales.passive: Mine inferno: the mine goblin burns 2 of the rival's health every 2 turns.

nahuales.name: Curupira
nahuales.passive: False trail: its backward feet confuse the rival: +8% evasion (15% in raids).

nahuales.name: Piuchén
nahuales.passive: Thirst: you heal 8% of the damage you deal.

nahuales.name: White Cadejo
nahuales.passive: Protector: you start with a 4 shield and, if you drop below 30%, it covers you with another of 6. In raids it heals the weakest ally.

nahuales.name: Black Cadejo
nahuales.passive: Stalker: +12% damage if the rival is below half health.

nahuales.name: Enchanted Boto
nahuales.passive: Charm: 5% chance the rival is enchanted and doesn't attack you (15% for the boss in raids).

nahuales.name: Witch Owl
nahuales.passive: Night vision: +6% crit and crits do x1.7 instead of x1.5.

nahuales.name: Alicanto
nahuales.passive: Gold: +4% loot and, at the start, dazzles the rival (30% to miss for 2 turns).

nahuales.name: Chaneque
nahuales.passive: Scare: on hit, 10% to stun the rival (once per fight).

nahuales.name: Mud Alux
nahuales.passive: Guardian: you take 4% less damage (10% in raids).

nahuales.name: Black Butterfly
nahuales.passive: Omen: it sees the rival's move coming: 8% to dodge their gift skills (10% of the boss's hits in raids).

nahuales.name: Fortune-telling Cuy
nahuales.passive: Good omen: +5% loot chance when you win.

zones.name: Aluxes' Cornfield
zones.desc: The Aluxes guard the cornfields of Yucatán. This is where you learn: nobody gets hurt.

zones.name: Curupira's Jungle
zones.desc: Tracks that point the wrong way. The Curupira protects his jungle.

zones.name: Altiplano of the Apus
zones.desc: The sacred peaks watch from above. Air is scarce and spirits are plenty.

zones.name: Pampas of the Luz Mala
zones.desc: Open fields and long nights. If you see a light, don't follow it.

zones.name: Sacred Cenotes
zones.desc: Crystal-clear sinkholes that lead to the Maya underworld.

zones.name: Amazon River
zones.desc: The biggest river in the world, and the mother of water lives in it.

zones.name: Salamanca Caves
zones.desc: Where the Devil teaches his arts in exchange for your soul. You can hear music inside.

zones.name: Supay's Mine
zones.desc: The tunnels of Potosí. Down below, Supay owns everything.

zones.name: Forest of the Cadejos
zones.desc: Two spectral dogs: one guards you, the other hunts you.

zones.name: Boitatá's Jungle
zones.desc: The fire serpent guards this jungle. The grass burns by itself.

zones.name: Rewe Hill
zones.desc: The machi's rewe connects the worlds. The kalku want to cut it down.

zones.name: Valley of La Llorona
zones.desc: By the river, at night, you hear a cry that chills the blood.

zones.name: Templo Mayor
zones.desc: The heart of Tenochtitlan. The smoking mirror is still smoking.

zones.name: Xibalbá
zones.desc: The Maya underworld. Its lords judge everyone who comes down.

zones.name: Mictlán, the nine levels
zones.desc: The Mexica realm of the dead. Each level is worse than the last.

zones.name: Road of the Sun
zones.desc: The Qhapaq Ñan leads to Inti himself. Only the strongest make it.

relics.name: Sun Macuahuitl
relics.desc: A club edged with obsidian blades. Under the sun it hits even harder.

relics.name: Quetzal Feather
relics.desc: A sacred feather that pulls you away from death once per fight.
relics.stats: +6 health, 6% esquivar, survives a lethal hit

relics.name: Funeral Mask
relics.desc: A jade mask for the journey to Mictlán. It lets you come back once.

relics.name: Florida Water
relics.desc: It cleanses energies and brings you back once.
relics.stats: 25% to cleanse each turn, revives once with 25% health

relics.name: Mom's Flip-Flop
relics.desc: It always hits, never misses and reaches from afar. It lands crits and terrifies the rival.
relics.stats: +5% damage, +8% crit, your hits can't be dodged, 15% to weaken on hit (-20% damage)

relics.name: Mom's Blessing
relics.desc: With mom's blessing, everything goes better.
relics.stats: +4% damage, +8 health, you start with +8⚡, +3% crit, 3% esquivar

relics.name: Sombrerón's Guitar
relics.desc: Its bewitched music puts whoever hears it to sleep.
relics.stats: +3% damage, +4 health, 10% to stun on hit

relics.name: Salamanca Poncho
relics.desc: Woven in the Salamanca: it stops gift powers, but takes your life bit by bit.
relics.stats: +8 health, -25% damage from gifts, loses 2 health per turn

relics.name: Luz Mala Lantern
relics.desc: A trapped will-o'-the-wisp: it disorients the enemy and makes you hard to follow.

relics.name: Cenote Jug
relics.desc: Sacred cenote water that seals the enemy's powers.
relics.stats: you start with +8⚡, 15% to seal on hit

relics.name: Healer's Rosary
relics.desc: Every bead is a prayer. It heals you bit by bit.

relics.name: Grandpa's Machete
relics.desc: Rusty, with the handle tied with wire... but it never failed. It gets better with every hunt you win.
relics.stats: +3% damage, +4% crit, +4% vs creatures, +1% damage every 50 hunts won (max +6%)

relics.name: Bombo Legüero Drum
relics.desc: Heard from a league away: its beat makes you hit harder.

relics.name: Embroidered Huipil
relics.desc: Every stitch is a protection against hexes.
relics.stats: +6 health, -15% damage from gifts, 20% to cleanse each turn

relics.name: Scapular
relics.desc: It saves you from a fatal blow once per fight.

relics.name: Seven-Color Candle
relics.desc: It powers up your great ritual: your ultimate attack hits harder.
relics.stats: you start with +8⚡, +20% Great Spell damage

relics.name: Palo Santo
relics.desc: It purifies the place: strong enemies lose power.

relics.name: Dad's Belt
relics.desc: A warning blow: the rival loses strength just from seeing it.
relics.stats: +3% damage, 20% to weaken on hit (-25% damage)

relics.name: Flying Slipper
relics.desc: The quick version of the flip-flop: it hits less, but it hits first.

relics.name: Grandma's Iron Skillet
relics.desc: It blocks the blow and sends it back.
relics.stats: +1% damage, starting shield 10, reflects 12% of damage

relics.name: Pressure Cooker
relics.desc: Boiling steam... with the risk it blows up on you.
relics.stats: +7% damage, loses 2 health per turn, 12% to burn on hit

relics.name: Mom's Look
relics.desc: It freezes the rival in fear of getting grounded.

relics.name: "Wait Till Your Father Gets Home"
relics.desc: A threat that comes true: backup arrives in two turns.
relics.stats: 15% for a 14 hit to land in 2 turn(s)

relics.name: The "You'll See"
relics.desc: It announces a huge blow that lands next turn.
relics.stats: 12% for a 20 hit to land in 1 turn(s)

relics.name: Hen Broth
relics.desc: It picks you up even when you're down.

relics.name: Ceremonial Tumi
relics.desc: A half-moon blade that breaks shields and barriers.

relics.name: Gauchito Gil's Facón
relics.desc: A quick, precise cut, the kind that gives no warning.

relics.name: Mulánima's Chain
relics.desc: A red-hot chain that leaves the rival burning.

relics.name: Ekeko's Bag
relics.desc: The god of abundance fills your pockets.

relics.name: Jade Necklace
relics.desc: The green stone protects the body and stokes your energy.

relics.name: Muiraquitã Amulet
relics.desc: A little green stone frog that protects from fire, poison and water.

relics.name: Fire Amulet
relics.desc: A Boitatá scale: it doesn't burn you and burns whoever touches you.
relics.stats: -30% burn damage, 10% to burn on hit

relics.name: Bush Knife
relics.desc: Made for clearing a path through forest and jungle. It cuts better against what lives there.

relics.name: Woodcutter's Axe
relics.desc: A slow, heavy blow that splits defenses like firewood.

relics.name: Drover's Whip
relics.desc: A quick blow that speeds you up and stuns the rival.
relics.stats: +2⚡ per turn, 7% to stun on hit

relics.name: Gaucho Lasso
relics.desc: It catches the rival and leaves them immobilized for a turn.

relics.name: Hunter's Blowgun
relics.desc: Darts with poison or sleep: you never know which one you'll get.
relics.stats: +1% damage, 12% to envenenar o aturdir on hit

relics.name: Algarrobo Club
relics.desc: Hard wood that stuns without spending energy.
relics.stats: +2% damage, you start with +10⚡, 6% to stun on hit

relics.name: Clay Comal
relics.desc: Hot food that restores you in the middle of a fight.

relics.name: Freshly Brewed Mate
relics.desc: It sharpens your focus: more critical hits.

relics.name: Silver Bombilla
relics.desc: Silver cleans the mate and, while it's at it, cleanses your ailments.

relics.name: Grandpa's Pot
relics.desc: A stew that gives health and endurance.

relics.name: Charango
relics.desc: Andean music that makes you faster.

relics.name: Quena
relics.desc: Its sound calms the rival and lowers their attack.
relics.stats: +3 health, 15% to weaken on hit (-20% damage)

relics.name: Clay Ocarina
relics.desc: Its song draws spirits in: better chance one joins you when you win.
relics.stats: +1 health per turn, +50% nahual chance from hunting

relics.name: Criollo Guitar
relics.desc: A song that eases fatigue.
relics.stats: you start with +5⚡, +3 health per turn

relics.name: Grandpa's Poncho
relics.desc: It keeps out cold and rain: you withstand lingering damage better.

relics.name: Wide-Brimmed Hat
relics.desc: It protects you from the sun and helps you dodge.

relics.name: Coca Pouch
relics.desc: A small woven pouch that gives energy and endurance.
relics.stats: +5 health, you start with +8⚡, +1⚡ per turn

relics.name: Grandma's Rosary
relics.desc: It protects you from spirits and heals you a bit each turn.
relics.stats: +2 health per turn, -10% damage from gifts

relics.name: Old Horseshoe
relics.desc: It attracts good luck and deflects hexes.

relics.name: Azabache Charm
relics.desc: It protects you from the evil eye and the rival's powers.
relics.stats: -8% damage from gifts, 25% to cleanse each turn

relics.name: Copal Incense
relics.desc: It cleanses the air and wards off spirits.
relics.stats: +4% vs creatures, 30% to cleanse each turn

relics.name: Rolling Pin
relics.desc: High close-range damage, with a chance to stun.

relics.name: Grandma's Ladle
relics.desc: Every blow comes with a little broth: it heals you a bit.

relics.name: House Broom
relics.desc: It sweeps the rival away and pushes them back.
relics.stats: +2% damage, 4% esquivar, 6% to stun on hit

relics.name: The Neighbor's Hose
relics.desc: Water everywhere: it soaks the rival and puts out your fires.

relics.name: The "Get Over Here!" Yell
relics.desc: It pulls them toward you and leaves them defenseless.

relics.name: The Full Name
relics.desc: When they hear their full name, the rival loses their turn.

relics.name: "When I Was Your Age..."
relics.desc: A lecture that stuns the rival or lowers their morale.
relics.stats: 12% to aturdir o debilitar on hit

relics.name: Vicks on the Chest
relics.desc: Brings the fever down: you withstand burns and poisons better.
relics.stats: 20% to cleanse each turn, -40% burn damage

relics.name: Hot Mate
relics.desc: Sharpens your focus.

relics.name: Family Photo
relics.desc: It protects you from sadness and fear.

relics.name: Dad's Wallet
relics.desc: It brings coins... hard to get them out, but they come out.

relics.name: Secret Home Remedy
relics.desc: Nobody knows what's in it: it might cure everything or taste awful.
relics.stats: a surprise effect in every fight

relics.name: Silver Bolas
relics.desc: They tangle around the rival's legs and leave them stuck.

relics.name: Curupira's Machete
relics.desc: It cuts your tracks: the rival can't tell where you're coming from.

relics.name: Seeing Stone
relics.desc: Looking through it you can see the rival's weaknesses.

relics.name: Cleansing Egg
relics.desc: Rolled over the body, it takes the evil eye away.

relics.name: Portable Apacheta
relics.desc: A pile of offering stones that protects you on the road.

relics.name: Chicha Bowl
relics.desc: Corn chicha that restores energy turn after turn.

relics.name: Miner's Pickaxe
relics.desc: Wherever it strikes, something breaks off: more materials when you win.

relics.name: Grandma's Hoe
relics.desc: It doesn't hit hard, but every blow gives you back a little health.

relics.name: Leather Lash
relics.desc: A lash that leaves a light bleed.

relics.name: Shepherd's Sling
relics.desc: Stones from afar: cheap, fast and always at hand.

relics.name: Blind Man's Cane
relics.desc: A simple cane that blocks and strikes back.

relics.name: Grandma's Knife
relics.desc: A nimble, precise cut, perfect for harvesting materials.

relics.name: Grandma's Wooden Spoon
relics.desc: It heals you a bit each turn (and watch it if you misbehave).

relics.name: Chocolate Whisk
relics.desc: It whips up energy and gives it back to you bit by bit.

relics.name: Heirloom Molcajete
relics.desc: It grinds whatever you find: you get more materials.

relics.name: Stone Metate
relics.desc: It grinds common materials until they become useful.

relics.name: Panpipes
relics.desc: One breath that disorients the rival.

relics.name: Maracas
relics.desc: Its noise scares off the weakest enemies.

relics.name: Ritual Rattle
relics.desc: Wards off spirits and minor hexes.
relics.stats: 20% to cleanse each turn, -15% burn damage

relics.name: Grandma's Shawl
relics.desc: It keeps you warm and covers you from blows.

relics.name: Worn Espadrilles
relics.desc: They've walked a thousand roads: light feet for dodging.

relics.name: Woven Sash
relics.desc: It protects your waist and gives you more health.

relics.name: Saint's Prayer Card
relics.desc: It brings luck: better loot.

relics.name: Deer's Eye
relics.desc: It wards off envy and adds defense.

relics.name: Sprig of Rue
relics.desc: It removes the evil eye and fears.

relics.name: Feather Duster
relics.desc: It dusts off ailments and cursed dust.

relics.name: Wet Mop
relics.desc: The rival slips and misses their blows.

relics.name: The Resigned Sigh
relics.desc: Takes a deep breath and recovers energy.

relics.name: Chicken Soup
relics.desc: Heals and removes ailments.
relics.stats: +2 health per turn, 25% to cleanse each turn

relics.name: Chamomile Tea
relics.desc: Calms you and recovers energy.
relics.stats: 10% to cleanse each turn, +2⚡ per turn

relics.name: Grandma's Ointment
relics.desc: Heals minor wounds right away.

relics.name: Heal, Heal, Little Frog's Tail
relics.desc: If it doesn't heal today, it'll heal tomorrow: you heal a bit each turn.

relics.name: Eternal Tupperware
relics.desc: It holds everything: you take home more materials.

relics.name: Grandma's Radio
relics.desc: Music that lifts your spirits.

relics.name: The 3 O'Clock Soap Opera
relics.desc: It distracts the rival and keeps them still for a turn.

relics.name: Rosary Hanging from the Mirror
relics.desc: It protects you on trips: you take a bit less damage from powers.

relics.name: Keychain with Every Key
relics.desc: It opens any chest (and jingles all over the house).

ranks.name: Apprentice
ranks.desc: Just arrived at the Tata's place. They still mix up rue and parsley.

ranks.name: Tracker
ranks.desc: They can follow tracks and cure a bellyache.

ranks.name: Pathfinder
ranks.desc: They know the woods like the back of their hand.

ranks.name: Healer
ranks.desc: They can go into the woods alone at night.

ranks.name: Senior Healer
ranks.desc: Up for promotion: they have to beat a Beast creature on their own.

ranks.name: Sage of the Woods
ranks.desc: The highest by normal means: even the Pombero respects them.

ranks.name: Master Healer
ranks.desc: People come from faraway villages to be healed by them.

ranks.name: Living Legend
ranks.desc: They speak to spirits as equals.

ranks.name: Elite Tracker
ranks.desc: Beyond the legends. Very few get there.

ranks.name: Tracker of the Century
ranks.desc: One shows up every hundred years.

ranks.name: The Strongest
ranks.desc: "You beat Supay with all his souls. Now you are, kid: the strongest." — the Tata
